release.title: Pushbullet Reborn and Classic — Beta 5
highlights: Classic push history is more faithful and faster to restore, with correct device targeting, previews, links, and recent activity.
Mirrored notifications now support app icons and images, dark mode, mute and unmute controls, and source-device dismissal.
File transfers show live progress across push, chat, and SMS/MMS; Pro-size files use Pushbullet's chunked upload flow with clearer authentication recovery.
Pushes received during sleep or a connection gap now return as fresh native notifications after wake or reconnect.
